TL:Dr/ Summery: Kickstarter and other crowd funding methods have no oversight and underwriting, This is why unethical people have been exploiting them. Any reform that is brought about to fix this, will cut off funds to the unethical journos, as well as other people who have scammed people but are not connected to the video game industry.

One of the issues that has come to light over the past year, is how flawed crowd funding is. Under the current model, there is no accountability, and there is no way to ensure that donations will be spent on what they were meant for.

There are two ways that this can be fixed: Either petition kickstarter to change its system, or write representatives and demand reform via laws.

Now, i find it unlikely for kickstarter to push or implement any reforms. They do not have the incentive to, as it will cost money on their part, and it will cut into their revenues.

The second option, will not only be more effective, but easier to implement. There are growing complaints in the legal system, about people falling for scams on kickstarter. Prosecutors are exhausting all the legal tools that they have, in attempts to prosecute instances of fraud on kickstarter. The problem is that the law has not caught up to the technology, and as such they are experiencing difficulty in recovering funds, or force performance.

this means that any reform we push through offical channels, may find support and approval from officials.

More importantly, this will also cut off funds towards unethical people, protect kickstarter backers, and help keep crowd funding as a viable option to people who do not have the credit for official loans.

Now, i understand that many people here, are against regulation. But this is something i feel should be talked about by the group. We have seen time and time again that many of the agitators in the anti movement, have been exploiting kicksarter for their own benefits. They are not the only one's doing this. Pushing for a reform, will not only cut off an important source of funds for them, but it will also bring their activities under scrutiny.

Scrutiny from the law, is something these people do not want.
